name: solove
description: Daniel Solove's Privacy Harm Taxonomy - 16 categories organized into 4 groups
source: Solove, D. J. (2006). A Taxonomy of Privacy. University of Pennsylvania Law Review, 154(3), 477-564.

rules.condition: monitoring OR tracking OR watching OR observing OR recording
rules.question_form: Is there monitoring, tracking, or surveillance of individuals?
rules.description: Watching, listening to, or recording of an individual's activities

rules.condition: questioning OR interrogating OR forced_disclosure OR compelled
rules.question_form: Are individuals compelled or pressured to disclose information?

rules.condition: combining OR aggregating OR profiling OR data_fusion OR linking
rules.question_form: Is data from multiple sources combined or aggregated?
rules.description: Combining various pieces of data about a person

rules.condition: identifying OR re-identification OR deanonymization OR linking_identity
rules.question_form: Can individuals be identified or re-identified from the data?

rules.condition: breach OR leak OR hack OR exposed OR vulnerable OR misconfigured
rules.question_form: Is data inadequately protected from breaches or unauthorized access?
rules.description: Carelessness in protecting stored information from leaks and improper access

rules.condition: repurpose OR secondary_use OR different_purpose OR without_consent OR sold
rules.question_form: Is data used for purposes beyond the original collection intent?
rules.description: Use of collected information for purposes different from assented purposes

rules.condition: no_access OR denied_access OR opaque OR no_correction OR no_deletion
rules.question_form: Are individuals excluded from knowledge or control of their data?
rules.description: Failure to allow data subjects to know about and participate in data handling

rules.condition: confidential AND (disclosed OR shared OR revealed)
rules.question_form: Has confidential information been improperly disclosed?
rules.description: Breaking a promise to keep information confidential

rules.condition: disclosure OR revealed OR exposed OR made_public
rules.question_form: Has true but private information been revealed to others?
rules.description: Revelation of truthful information that damages reputation

rules.condition: exposed OR naked OR intimate OR bodily
rules.question_form: Has intimate or bodily information been exposed?
rules.description: Revealing physical or emotional attributes of a person

rules.condition: public_database OR searchable OR indexed OR accessible
rules.question_form: Has personal information been made more accessible than before?
rules.description: Amplifying accessibility of already available information

rules.condition: blackmail OR extortion OR ransom OR threat_disclosure
rules.question_form: Is there blackmail or extortion using personal information?

rules.condition: appropriation OR identity_theft OR impersonation OR stolen_identity
rules.question_form: Has someone's identity or likeness been appropriated?
rules.description: Use of one's identity or personality for another's purposes

rules.condition: distortion OR misrepresentation OR false_light OR manipulated
rules.question_form: Has information about a person been distorted or misrepresented?
rules.description: Dissemination of false or misleading information

rules.condition: intrusion OR invasion OR unwanted_contact OR harassment
rules.question_form: Is there unwanted intrusion into someone's private space or affairs?
rules.description: Invasive acts that disturb one's tranquility or solitude

rules.condition: manipulation OR coercion OR dark_pattern OR nudge OR algorithmic_decision
rules.question_form: Is there interference with personal decision-making through manipulation?
rules.description: Government or private sector intrusion into personal decisions
